purpose: Models #574 scoped production MPK acceptance using genuine, unchanged compiled artifacts
guards: Capture the latest complete production Develop document and canonical snapshot before mutation.
Require no pre-existing approved selection for this model/profile.
Preserve every existing build, package, other profile and other model.
Publish through the snapshot API with compare-and-swap; stop on conflicts.
Run the existing protected workflow from develop; do not bypass review.
Verify promoted receipt and exact MPK checksum and size before cleanup.
Under the repository row lock, withdraw only the fixture approval matching its promotion UUID and candidate, release only its approved_selection hold, and audit the operator cleanup.
Restore only the captured model policy/requirements using the current snapshot API, preserving unrelated concurrent catalog progress.
Never delete compile/package runs, candidate records, source objects, or approval history.
cleanup_constraint: There is no withdrawal API. Successful fixture cleanup requires a guarded operator database transaction before ordinary catalog restoration; a source-only policy revert is insufficient.
